Samir — thanks for the clear asks. Short version up front: Redwood bills on billed tokens (post-tokenization) — both input and output tokens count when they are part of the request. Cached prefix tokens are NOT billed repeatedly on every response when served from our cache; we bill the tokens that are actually transferred/consumed by the model for that request. Below is a worked example based on your call assumptions.

Worked example (rounded):
Assumptions
- Active monthly users: 25,000
- Avg sessions/user/month: 3 (75k sessions/month total)
- Avg input chars/session: 200 chars -> ~45 input tokens (example conversion: ~4.4 chars/token for mixed English)
- Avg output chars/session: 800 chars -> ~180 output tokens
- Avg system prompt (prefix) length: 300 tokens, but cached for repeated sessions across same user cohort

Per-session billed tokens (when cache hits):
- Input tokens: 45
- Output tokens: 180
- System prompt: 0 (cache hit)
- Total billed per session: 225 tokens

Monthly billed tokens: 225 tokens * 75,000 sessions = 16,875,000 billed tokens (~16.9M)

Pricing scenarios (target $/1M billed tokens) — map to Atlas budget band
- Low-cost scenario ($8 / 1M tokens): 16.875M * $8/1M = $135.00 -> $135 (this is illustrative; platform minimums/other fees not included)
- Mid scenario ($120 / 1M tokens): 16.875M * $120/1M = $2,025 -> $2,025
- High (enterprise, $1,200 / 1M tokens): 16.875M * $1,200/1M = $20,250 -> $20,250

Notes on above:
- The $/1M figure should include both input + output billed tokens. The pricing tiers in the attached excerpt show example ranges; final price depends on committed volume and contract term.
- If cache miss occurs (e.g., first request or different user cohorts), the system prompt tokens would be billed for that request. For example, a cache miss adds ~300 tokens to that session (making billed tokens ~525 for that session).
- We also recommend measuring tokens per request on a 2-week sample so you can model real cache hit rates; a 70–90% prefix cache hit rate materially changes monthly billed tokens.

- Irene: please schedule a 30-min follow-up with Atlas procurement next week; include Grace for commercial sign-off.

Cheers,
